script.problem: It has 7 sentences. Each paragraph is 3 to 4 sentences.

terra.problem: Proverbs 25:18 compares bearing false witness against a neighbor—not careless speech in general—to a club, sword, or sharp arrow.
Saying almost every proverb is about holding back overstates the theme. Many address other matters, including trustworthy messengers, wise rebuke, good news, and kindness to enemies.
